issues: 九张灰色背面就是灰块 + 圆点，开场 20f 画面像加载失败的占位
正面是满屏小字的通用 dashboard 卡，翻完读不出任何信息，翻面没有"揭晓"的回报
浅灰底 + 灰卡 + 白卡，全程没有一个颜色和视觉重心
翻转只有 ease-in-out，没有预备，九张卡像同一个机械动作复制九遍
changes: look 换成 porcelain（冷白 · 钴蓝）：九张背面拼成一整块钴蓝海报，290px 粗黑体 Plan. / Build. / Ship. 左中右错落、被格缝切开，第 1 帧就是一张完整海报
正面是虚构产品「Oriel」的九个功能卡，按海报三行分组（PLAN / BUILD / SHIP）：64px 钴蓝图标块 + 50px 标题 + 32px 一句话；墙心一张钴蓝实底主角卡做收尾重心
12–28f 一道斜向柔光沿对角线扫过海报，预示波前方向（整墙只这一次）
翻转曲线改为 bezier(0.5,-0.22,0.3,1)：先向后微仰 ~6° 再翻过去；对角波前 (row+col)×6f、每张 16f，只有尾张冲到 192° 再弹回
保留共享消失点 / 按角度选面 / cos 压暗 / 90° 高光线 / 独立地面影，改为两层带色相软阴影；整墙全程 1.000→1.025 极缓推进
issuesEn: The nine grey backs were grey blocks with a dot, so the first 20f looked like a failed-to-load placeholder
The fronts were generic dashboard cards full of tiny text, so nothing was readable after the flip and the reveal had no payoff
Light grey stage, grey cards, white cards: no colour and no focal point anywhere in the shot
The flip used a plain ease-in-out with no anticipation, so the nine cards looked like one mechanical move copied nine times
changesEn: Porcelain look (cool white, cobalt): the nine backs tile one cobalt poster, with 290px heavy type Plan. / Build. / Ship. staggered left, centre and right and sliced by the gutters, so frame one is already a complete poster

The fronts are nine feature cards for a fictional product "Oriel", grouped by the poster's rows (PLAN / BUILD / SHIP): a 64px cobalt icon tile, a 50px title and a 32px one-liner; the centre card is a solid cobalt hero that anchors the final frame
From 12f to 28f a soft diagonal light sweeps the poster along the diagonal, previewing the wave direction (once for the whole wall)
Flip curve changed to bezier(0.5,-0.22,0.3,1): each card tips back ~6° before flipping over; diagonal wavefront (row+col)×6f, 16f per card, and only the last card overshoots to 192° before settling

Kept the shared vanishing point, angle-based face selection, cos shading, the 90° glint line and the separate floor shadows, now as two tinted soft shadow layers; the whole wall pushes very slowly from 1.000 to 1.025
